des.dragonrise_reforge.cluster_charge: Can only be placed on the side or floor of a block. After arming, fires 5 grenades in a fan through the surface
des.dragonrise_reforge.r6_drone: Deploy it, then link with the Monitor: WASD to move, Ctrl to sprint, Space to jump toward your view (2s cooldown)
des.dragonrise_reforge.un_helmet: Thank you for your service and sacrifice
dragonrise_reforge:aim54: AIM-54 Phoenix Active Radar Air-to-Air Missile
info.dragonrise_reforge.2s25m: 2S25 Sprut-SDM1 self-propelled anti-tank gun, a light amphibious tank destroyer developed by Russia. Armed with a 125mm 2A75 smoothbore gun on a BMD-4M airborne chassis, it offers excellent amphibious mobility and serves as key fire support for Russian naval infantry and airborne troops.
info.dragonrise_reforge.2s38: 2S38 Derivatsiya-PVO air defense/fire support vehicle, a new Russian self-propelled anti-aircraft gun based on the BMP-3 chassis. Equipped with a 57mm high-rate autocannon and advanced search and fire control radars, it can effectively intercept low-altitude drones and helicopters while posing a serious threat to light armored ground targets.
info.dragonrise_reforge.625e: 625E gun-missile integrated field air defense system, a new wheeled self-propelled air defense system integrating a small phased array radar, electro-optical fire control, air defense missiles and a 6-barrel 25mm gatling cannon. Mainly used for on-the-move air defense accompanying mechanized forces, intercepting low-altitude aircraft, helicopters and precision-guided bombs.
info.dragonrise_reforge.9m133: 9M133 Kornet-E anti-tank missile, a laser beam-riding anti-tank missile developed by the KBP Instrument Design Bureau of Russia. With a maximum range of 5,500 meters and penetration of about 1,200mm of rolled homogeneous armor, it is widely used on infantry, armored vehicles and helicopters.
info.dragonrise_reforge.aav7a1: AAV7A1 amphibious assault vehicle, the main amphibious armored personnel carrier of the US Marine Corps, manufactured by BAE Systems. Equipped with the UGWS weapon station mounting an Mk19 40mm automatic grenade launcher and an M2HB 12.7mm heavy machine gun. The hull uses welded aluminum armor and can be fitted with EAAK add-on armor kits to resist 14.5mm armor-piercing rounds. Carrying 3 crew and 21 fully equipped Marines, it reaches 72 km/h on land and 13 km/h on water, making it the core equipment of US amphibious landing operations.
info.dragonrise_reforge.aavc7c1: AAVC7C1 amphibious assault command vehicle, the command variant of the AAV7 series. The UGWS weapon station is removed, retaining only a 7.62mm M240 machine gun for self-defense. The troop compartment is converted into a communications command center equipped with multiple VRC-92, VRC-89, PRC-103 and MRC-83 tactical radio systems, carrying 3 crew and 10 command staff to provide forward command and control for amphibious operations.
info.dragonrise_reforge.ac130: AC-130 gunship, a special attack aircraft of the US Air Force converted from the C-130 transport. Armed with a 105mm howitzer, 40mm autocannon and 25mm gatling cannon, it is mainly used for close air support and fire suppression, making it a highly deterrent aerial weapons platform.
info.dragonrise_reforge.ah1f: AH-1F Cobra attack helicopter, a classic attack helicopter model developed by Bell. As the final production variant of the AH-1 series, it is armed with a 20mm M197 three-barrel gatling cannon and can carry TOW anti-tank missiles. After years of US service, it remains widely exported to many countries and regions.
info.dragonrise_reforge.ah64: AH-64 Apache attack helicopter, one of the most powerful and advanced attack helicopters in the world, renowned for its heavy weapon load, advanced avionics and survivability. The nose-mounted night vision and sensor turret gives it all-weather combat capability.
info.dragonrise_reforge.akm: AKM Hornet combat vehicle, a light armored vehicle resembling a small tank or heavy armored car, possibly from a sci-fi or parallel world setting, with strong mobility and firepower.
info.dragonrise_reforge.amx56: AMX-56 Leclerc main battle tank, the main battle tank of the French Army and considered one of the most compact in the world. Featuring an autoloader, advanced modular composite armor and digital fire control, it is a masterpiece of Western European tank design.
info.dragonrise_reforge.av8b: AV-8B Harrier II attack aircraft (in testing), a short/vertical takeoff and landing attack aircraft used by the US Marine Corps, developed from the British Harrier GR.Mk5. It can be deployed on amphibious assault ships and forward bases to provide close air support. The current version is a test model.
info.dragonrise_reforge.bmd4m: BMD-4M airborne combat vehicle, Russia's latest airborne infantry fighting vehicle armed with a 100mm 2A70 gun and a 30mm autocannon. It can be airdropped by Il-76 transport aircraft and features excellent mobility and amphibious capability, making it the core equipment of the Russian VDV airborne troops.
info.dragonrise_reforge.bmp3: BMP-3 infantry fighting vehicle, a unique Russian IFV with extremely powerful firepower. Its main weapons include a 100mm 2A70 rifled gun (capable of firing gun-launched missiles), a 30mm 2A72 autocannon and a 7.62mm PKT machine gun, with a distinctive crew and passenger compartment layout.
info.dragonrise_reforge.bmpt72: BMPT-72 fire support combat vehicle, also known as the Terminator-2, converted from the T-72 tank chassis. The original turret is removed and replaced with a new unmanned weapon station armed with two 30mm autocannons, four anti-tank missiles and a machine gun, designed to protect tanks and eliminate high-threat targets in urban and counter-insurgency warfare.
info.dragonrise_reforge.brdm2: BRDM-2, an amphibious wheeled reconnaissance vehicle developed by the Molotov Automobile Plant in Gorky, Soviet Union in the early 1960s.
info.dragonrise_reforge.camel: CAMEL, a retro-looking propeller aircraft or flying vehicle, possibly belonging to a civilization at an early technological level or serving as a low-speed recreational aircraft.
info.dragonrise_reforge.challenger_ds: Challenger DS main battle tank, a modernized variant of the British Challenger series. Armed with a 120mm rifled gun, it features advanced composite armor and digital fire control systems, serving as the backbone of the British Army's armored forces.
info.dragonrise_reforge.churchill_vii: Churchill VII heavy tank, a British heavy infantry tank developed during World War II, renowned for its thick armor and good off-road performance. Armed with a 75mm tank gun, it played an important role in the Normandy landings and trench warfare on the European front.
info.dragonrise_reforge.cm34: CM-34 Cloud Leopard armored vehicle, the fire support variant of Taiwan's indigenous 8x8 wheeled armored vehicle family. Its main weapon is an Mk44 30mm chain gun, used for infantry support and fire suppression missions.
info.dragonrise_reforge.comet: Comet cruiser tank, a fast tank developed by Britain in the late World War II. Armed with a 77mm QF 17-pounder gun, it offered excellent mobility and firepower and was one of Britain's main tanks in the late war.
info.dragonrise_reforge.csk181: CSK-181 Mengshi armored assault vehicle, a new-generation high-mobility armored vehicle produced by Dongfeng Motor. Compared to earlier models, its protection, payload and informatization level are greatly improved. It can carry a full infantry squad and is the core assault equipment of the PLA light combined-arms brigades.
info.dragonrise_reforge.cv90: CV90 infantry fighting vehicle, a series of Swedish tracked armored fighting vehicles renowned for excellent mobility, modular design and good protection. Different turrets and weapon systems can be fitted according to mission requirements.
info.dragonrise_reforge.cyborg_tank: Annihilation Tank, a semi-mechanized combat vehicle whose design plagiarizes Super Earth but with inferior performance. Its unstable combination of mechanical and biological structures is riddled with design flaws, so much so that criticizing it is a waste of time.
info.dragonrise_reforge.dshk: DShK heavy machine gun, a 12.7mm large-caliber machine gun developed and widely used by the Soviet Union during World War II, nicknamed Dushka. Mounted on a wheeled tripod for both ground and anti-aircraft fire, it was an important air defense and anti-armor weapon for Red Army infantry and widely fitted on tanks as an anti-aircraft machine gun.
info.dragonrise_reforge.ec665: EC665 Tiger attack helicopter, a modern attack helicopter jointly developed by France and Germany, renowned for excellent maneuverability, advanced glass cockpit and powerful air-to-ground/air-to-air weapon systems. It is the world's first attack helicopter designed with air combat capability as a design requirement.
info.dragonrise_reforge.f14: F-14 Tomcat fighter, a twin-seat, twin-engine supersonic carrier-based fighter formerly used by the US Navy. Famous for its variable-sweep wing design and the powerful combination of the AWG-9 radar and AIM-54 Phoenix missiles, it was mainly used for fleet air defense and air superiority.
info.dragonrise_reforge.f16c: F-16C Fighting Falcon fighter, a single-engine multirole fighter developed by General Dynamics. Renowned worldwide for excellent maneuverability and multirole capability, it is one of the best-selling fighters in the world and a mainstay of air forces in dozens of countries and regions.
info.dragonrise_reforge.f4u: F4U Corsair fighter, a carrier-based fighter developed by Vought with a distinctive inverted gull wing design and a powerful Pratt & Whitney R-2800 engine. In the Pacific War it became a nightmare for Japanese fighters and was hailed by US troops as the Angel of the Battlefield.
info.dragonrise_reforge.fa18e: F/A-18E Super Hornet, the latest carrier-based multirole fighter of the US Navy, developed from the F/A-18 Hornet with a larger airframe, more powerful engines and advanced avionics. Capable of air superiority, ground attack and electronic warfare missions.
info.dragonrise_reforge.fav_a: FAV-A fast attack vehicle, a light, highly mobile desert off-road vehicle usually built from a tubular steel frame. Light and fast, it can carry a small crew with machine guns or grenade launchers for rapid reconnaissance, infiltration and raids.
info.dragonrise_reforge.hj8: HJ-8 Red Arrow-8 anti-tank missile, China's second-generation tube-launched anti-tank missile using optical aiming, semi-automatic infrared guidance and wire command transmission. It is an important anti-tank weapon for PLA infantry and armored units and has been widely exported to the Middle East, Africa and other regions.
info.dragonrise_reforge.hyr0: Super Citizen HYR0, with formidable overall performance, but its frequent and violent breakdowns and high cost have made its crew miserable, though it still achieved glorious records in the past.
info.dragonrise_reforge.is2: IS-2 heavy tank, a Soviet heavy tank developed in the late World War II to counter German Tiger and Panther tanks. Armed with a 122mm D-25T gun with powerful firepower and thick armor, it was the spearhead of Soviet breakthrough operations.
info.dragonrise_reforge.j10: J-10 fighter, nicknamed Vigorous Dragon, a milestone in the Chinese aviation industry. With a large delta wing and canard layout, it has excellent maneuverability. Early models are equipped with pulse-Doppler radar and can perform air superiority, ground attack and other missions.
info.dragonrise_reforge.j10c: J-10C fighter, the latest improved variant of the J-10 series. It is fitted with an AESA radar and more advanced integrated avionics, giving it longer detection range and stronger anti-jamming capability, and can carry more advanced air-to-air missiles and precision ground-attack munitions, reaching the top level of 3.5-generation fighters.
info.dragonrise_reforge.j11: J-11B fighter, a heavy fighter produced through localization and deep improvement of the imported Su-27SK. Fitted with domestic fire control radar, avionics and weapons, it can launch domestic active radar-guided air-to-air missiles and possesses strong beyond-visual-range air combat capability.
info.dragonrise_reforge.j15t: J-15T Feisha fighter, a single-seat heavy carrier-based fighter independently developed by China, led by Shenyang Aircraft Industry Group. Based on the J-15, it focuses on improving avionics, weapon systems and platform performance, further emphasizing carrier characteristics and maritime suitability as a catapult-launched carrier aircraft. As the core weapon of carrier battle groups, it is an important force of the Chinese naval aviation.
info.dragonrise_reforge.j16: J-16 fighter, a twin-seat, twin-engine heavy multirole fighter developed from the Su-30MK2. Equipped with an AESA radar and various precision-guided weapons, it has powerful air-to-air, air-to-ground and air-to-sea strike capability and is nicknamed the Bomb Truck.
info.dragonrise_reforge.j20: J-20 fighter, nicknamed Mighty Dragon, China's fifth-generation stealth fighter. Featuring a canard aerodynamic layout and all-moving vertical tails, it has high stealth, high situational awareness and high maneuverability, and is one of the few operational fifth-generation fighters in the world.
info.dragonrise_reforge.j20vtol: J-20C multirole fighter (incomplete), a sci-fi aircraft from the movie The Wandering Earth 2. Improved from the J-20 with added vertical takeoff and landing capability to adapt to future environments with more demanding takeoff and landing requirements. The current version is a concept showcase and is not yet complete.
info.dragonrise_reforge.j35: J-35 fighter, a fifth-generation carrier-based fighter developed by Shenyang Aircraft Corporation. Featuring a twin-engine, single-seat conventional layout, it has stealth capability, advanced avionics and a strong weapon load, and will be deployed on Chinese Navy aircraft carriers in the future.
info.dragonrise_reforge.j8: J-8B interceptor, an important improved variant of the J-8 series. It is fitted with a more powerful WP-13A turbojet engine, side intakes instead of nose intake, and a new fire control radar, giving it all-weather interception and medium-range air combat capability. It is jokingly called the Airborne Handsome Man.
info.dragonrise_reforge.jas39e: JAS 39E Gripen fighter, the latest model of Saab's JAS 39 Gripen. Fitted with a more powerful engine, AESA radar and new avionics, it has significantly increased payload and range, making it a flexible and efficient light multirole fighter.
info.dragonrise_reforge.jf17: JF-17/FC-1 Thunder/Xiaolong fighter, a light single-engine multirole fighter jointly developed by China and Pakistan. Featuring low cost, low maintenance and multirole capability, it mainly replaces the aging Mirage and Q-5 series and has become one of the mainstays of the Pakistan Air Force.
info.dragonrise_reforge.ka50: Ka-50 attack helicopter, NATO reporting name Hokum, the world's first single-seat attack helicopter. Its unique coaxial rotor design eliminates the tail rotor, giving it excellent maneuverability and low maintenance requirements. It is armed with a fixed cannon and various anti-tank missiles.
info.dragonrise_reforge.kv1: KV-1 heavy tank, a Soviet heavy tank that entered service in the early World War II. Known for its strong armor and 76.2mm main gun, it provided important armored support to the Red Army in the early days of the Great Patriotic War and was a key weapon against the German invasion.
info.dragonrise_reforge.l1a2: Flakpanzer Gepard 1A2 self-propelled anti-aircraft gun, an all-weather air defense system developed by Krauss-Maffei Wegmann (KMW) of Germany on the Leopard 1 tank chassis, entering service in 1976. It is armed with twin 35mm Oerlikon GDF anti-aircraft cannons, each with 320 rounds of anti-aircraft ammunition and 20 rounds of armor-piercing ammunition, with a muzzle velocity of 1,440 m/s and an effective range of 5.5 km. It carries a Siemens MPDR 12 S-band search radar (15 km range) and a Ku-band tracking radar, powered by an MTU multifuel engine (830 hp) with a top speed of 65 km/h and a maximum range of 550 km. About 582 units were procured by Germany, Belgium, the Netherlands and others, and it has participated in NATO operations in Kosovo and Afghanistan. Since 2022, Ukraine has also used this system to counter Russian drones.
info.dragonrise_reforge.leopard2a4: Leopard 2A4 main battle tank, a third-generation main battle tank developed by Krauss-Maffei Wegmann (KMW) of Germany, the most produced and most widely exported variant of the Leopard 2 series. It is armed with a Rheinmetall Rh-120 L/44 120mm smoothbore gun, powered by an MTU MB 873 Ka-501 engine (1,500 hp), and fitted with modular composite armor with frontal turret protection equivalent to about 600-700mm of rolled homogeneous armor. In production since 1985 with about 2,500 units built, it has been adopted by 19 countries and is one of the most successful Western export tanks.
info.dragonrise_reforge.lvt: LVT amphibious armored vehicle, an amphibious armored fighting vehicle developed and widely used by the United States during World War II. Capable of water travel and beach landing, it played an irreplaceable transport and landing support role in the island campaigns of the Pacific theater.
info.dragonrise_reforge.m10booker: M10 Booker tank, a new American medium tank whose main weapon is a 105mm gun with an advanced fire control system, suitable for a variety of combat environments.
info.dragonrise_reforge.m113: M113 armored personnel carrier, the most widely used light tracked armored personnel carrier of the US military. Using aluminum armor with excellent mobility, it has been fielded in more than 50 countries and regions since entering service in 1960, making it the highest-production armored vehicle in the Western world.
info.dragonrise_reforge.m1a1hc: M1A1 Abrams Main Battle Tank, the first mass-produced improved variant of the M1 Abrams series. Equipped with an M256 120mm smoothbore gun, composite armor, and gas turbine power system, it served as the main battle tank of the US Army from the late Cold War to the early 21st century.
info.dragonrise_reforge.m1a2sepv2: M1A2 SEPv2 Abrams main battle tank, an upgrade of the M1A2 SEP. Its main improvements include a third-generation improved forward-looking infrared system for stronger day/night target detection, and an upgraded in-vehicle digital network that lets crew share battlefield information more efficiently.
info.dragonrise_reforge.m2: M2HB heavy machine gun, the Browning M2HB .50 caliber heavy machine gun in service since the end of World War I. Famous for its power, reliability and versatility, it can inflict heavy damage on light armored targets, low-flying aircraft and personnel, and is one of the most successful heavy machine gun designs in history.
info.dragonrise_reforge.m270: M270 MLRS, a US tracked multiple launch rocket system. Equipped with two rocket pods that can fire 12 rockets or two ATACMS missiles, it provides long-range area saturation fire support.
info.dragonrise_reforge.m3a3: M3A3 Bradley cavalry fighting vehicle. The M3 Bradley is the version used by US cavalry (reconnaissance) units, similar to the M2 IFV but with the troop compartment converted to store more ammunition. The A3 model upgrades digital fire control, navigation and communications systems, greatly improving its reconnaissance and target acquisition capability.
info.dragonrise_reforge.m3stuart: M3 Stuart is a light tank finalized by the American Car and Foundry Company in July 1940, mainly used for reconnaissance and rapid mobile operations during World War II.
info.dragonrise_reforge.m4a2: M4A2 Sherman medium tank, one of the main tanks produced by the United States during World War II. Using a General Motors diesel engine and armed with a 75mm M3 tank gun, it is known for its reliability, high production volume and easy maintenance, and was mainly supplied to the US Marine Corps and the Soviet Red Army.
info.dragonrise_reforge.m4a2_105: M4A2 (105mm) Sherman tank, a Sherman variant armed with a 105mm M4 howitzer for close infantry fire support, firing high-explosive shells to destroy enemy fortifications and bunkers.
info.dragonrise_reforge.markv: Mark V tank (male), a British tank developed during World War I.
info.dragonrise_reforge.maus: Maus super-heavy tank, a super-heavy tank developed by Nazi Germany at the end of World War II and the heaviest tank ever built. Armed with a 128mm KwK 44 gun and a 75mm KwK 44 secondary gun with extremely thick armor but very poor mobility, only two prototypes were produced.
info.dragonrise_reforge.mk19: MK-19 grenade launcher, a 40mm fully automatic grenade launcher that can be mounted on vehicles, ships or tripods. It can fire high-explosive, armor-piercing or training grenades at a high rate of fire, providing infantry with powerful area suppression firepower.
info.dragonrise_reforge.motuo: Boy-brand motorcycle with sidecar, a civilian three-wheeled motorcycle that is slow and has almost no protection, but offers a unique driving pleasure and serves as an amusing short-distance transport in non-combat environments.
info.dragonrise_reforge.mv3: MV-3, a Chinese high-mobility tactical truck produced by Dongfeng, used for logistics transport and troop movement in mechanized units.
info.dragonrise_reforge.nh90: NH90 medium utility helicopter, a twin-engine multirole helicopter jointly developed by France, Germany, Italy and the Netherlands. Featuring a composite fuselage and fly-by-wire controls, it can perform transport, search and rescue, anti-submarine and other missions, and is one of Europe's most advanced medium helicopters.
info.dragonrise_reforge.npds114: NPDS114 auto turret, a fixed or semi-fixed automatic weapon station equipped with a light cannon or heavy machine gun for position defense or key-point protection, capable of autonomously searching, identifying and engaging targets.
info.dragonrise_reforge.npds514: NPDS514 auto turret, the medium automatic weapon station of the NPDS series with stronger firepower and a more advanced sensor suite, effective against light armored targets and low-altitude slow-flying aircraft.
info.dragonrise_reforge.npds810: NPDS810 auto turret, the flagship automatic weapon station of the NPDS series, integrating phased array radar and electro-optical fire control with strong multi-target interception capability, providing an automated solution for key-point air defense.
info.dragonrise_reforge.pak40: A 75mm anti-tank gun commissioned by Nazi Germany in 1939 from Krupp and Rheinmetall-Borsig.
info.dragonrise_reforge.panzer4: Panzer IV H, the main tank of Nazi Germany in the mid-to-late World War II and the most important and most produced variant of the Panzer IV series. Armed with a 75mm KwK 40 L/48 tank gun and fitted with side skirts for enhanced protection.
info.dragonrise_reforge.pershing: M26 Pershing heavy tank, a heavy tank developed by the United States at the end of World War II to counter German Tiger tanks. Armed with a 90mm M3 tank gun with good armor protection and firepower, it was the main tank of the US Army in the late war and was also widely used in the Korean War.
info.dragonrise_reforge.project640: Project 640 main battle tank, a fictional experimental tank project whose number pays tribute to China's 640 anti-ballistic missile defense program. This tank may carry many immature black technologies such as laser defense systems or electromagnetic armor, making it a product of technological exploration.
info.dragonrise_reforge.pzbjy: Obstacle Clearing Northern Golden Eagle engineering armored vehicle, a heavy armored engineering vehicle specialized in obstacle breaching and battlefield clearance. Equipped with mine-clearing devices and a dozer blade, it can clear minefields and other artificial obstacles for main forces.
info.dragonrise_reforge.q5: Q-5 attack aircraft, China's first independently developed jet ground-attack aircraft, mainly used for low-altitude and very-low-altitude ground attack. With large payload, good low-altitude performance and rugged structure, it long served as the mainstay of PLA Air Force ground support.
info.dragonrise_reforge.qjz89: QJZ-89 heavy machine gun, the 12.7mm heavy machine gun currently in service with the People's Liberation Army. Compared to the older Type 85 and Type 77, the Type 89 uses large amounts of light alloys and titanium alloys, greatly reducing weight and giving it excellent mobility. It is an important fire support weapon at the infantry battalion and company level.
info.dragonrise_reforge.refale: Rafale fighter, a twin-engine, delta-wing, high-maneuverability multirole fighter developed by Dassault of France. One of the representatives of 3.5-generation fighters, it can perform air superiority, ground attack, anti-ship, reconnaissance and other missions, and has strong nuclear strike capability.
info.dragonrise_reforge.refaleaa: Rafale fighter (naval variant), the carrier-based Rafale developed for the French Navy with reinforced landing gear and an arrestor hook to meet carrier takeoff and landing requirements, with combat capability essentially identical to the Air Force variant.
info.dragonrise_reforge.sd905: SD 905 unmanned combat vehicle, an intelligent unmanned armored platform equipped with optical sensors and various weapon systems. It can perform forward reconnaissance, target designation or direct fire strike missions, and is an exploratory model for future unmanned warfare.
info.dragonrise_reforge.shield: Portable shield, a foldable protective barrier for individuals or small teams that can be quickly deployed into a simple bulletproof screen, providing temporary cover for infantry in urban and defensive operations.
info.dragonrise_reforge.spacebag: Space Bag, a device or vehicle capable of providing survival support within a small area, used to maintain basic life support in space environments.
info.dragonrise_reforge.strv103: Strv 103 main battle tank, nicknamed the S-Tank, a Swedish turretless tank design. The gun is rigidly fixed to the hull and aimed by pitching and turning the hull, an extremely unique design concept aimed at reducing vehicle height and simplifying structure.
info.dragonrise_reforge.su24m: Su-24M Fencer-D fighter-bomber, a modernized variant of the Su-24 with upgraded navigation/attack systems, electronic warfare equipment and greater weapon compatibility. It can carry Kh-25 anti-radiation missiles, KAB-500 guided bombs and other precision-guided weapons.
info.dragonrise_reforge.sx1: SX-1, an armored reconnaissance or fire support vehicle with stealth-oriented design. Its specific model and tactical purpose are unclear; it may be used for high-risk forward reconnaissance and target designation strike missions.
info.dragonrise_reforge.syy651: SYY-651 test vehicle, an experimental special armored platform with limited performance parameters, mainly used for verification and testing in specific tactical scenarios.
info.dragonrise_reforge.t3476: T-34/76 medium tank, one of the most famous Soviet tanks of World War II and an early model of the T-34 series. Armed with a 76.2mm F-34 gun, its perfect combination of sloped armor, Christie suspension and wide tracks achieved an excellent balance of mobility, protection and firepower.
info.dragonrise_reforge.t3485: T-34-85 medium tank, a major Soviet improvement of the T-34 during World War II to counter German tank threats. Armed with an 85mm ZIS-S-53 gun with thicker armor and stronger firepower, it was the main tank of the Soviet military during the war.
info.dragonrise_reforge.t72b3: T-72B3 main battle tank, a modernized variant of the Soviet T-72B. Equipped with a 125mm smoothbore gun, a new fire control system and Relikt explosive reactive armor, it significantly improves firepower and protection.
info.dragonrise_reforge.t80: T-80BVM main battle tank, a modernized variant of the T-80 series optimized for Arctic and severe cold operations. Fitted with new Relikt explosive reactive armor, a more advanced fire control system and the 2A46M-4 125mm smoothbore gun, it retains the high mobility advantage of its gas turbine power.
info.dragonrise_reforge.t80b: T-80B main battle tank, an important variant of the T-80 series armed with the 125mm 2A46M-1 smoothbore gun and gas turbine power. One of the first Soviet tanks capable of firing gun-launched missiles, it was the main equipment of Soviet forces in Germany and elite units in the late Cold War.
info.dragonrise_reforge.t90mh: T-90M Proryv main battle tank, the latest deep modernization of the T-90 series with a completely new turret design, a more powerful engine, new reactive armor and a digital fire control system. Its protection, mobility and informatization have reached world-leading levels.
info.dragonrise_reforge.t90mhigh: T-90M (Elevated) main battle tank, a variant of the T-90M that may raise the turret ring or hull height above the standard T-90M to enhance performance in certain combat environments.
info.dragonrise_reforge.test: Test entity, a placeholder entity used only for development and debugging, with no actual in-game purpose.
info.dragonrise_reforge.test_ship: Test ship, a placeholder ship entity used only for development and debugging, with no actual in-game purpose.
info.dragonrise_reforge.tiger: Tiger heavy tank, the most legendary tank of Nazi Germany in the early and mid World War II. Known for its thick armor and powerful 88mm KwK 36 L/56 tank gun, it put enormous pressure on Allied forces on the battlefield.
info.dragonrise_reforge.tjgc: TJP-F01 Tianji, a space fighter developed by stars Xingchen IL, whose performance and technical parameters are highly classified.
info.dragonrise_reforge.toyota_seiki: Toyota Century black luxury sedan, a luxury car with great political symbolism. Featuring heavy armored protection and a solemn appearance, it is usually used to transport senior officials and for important diplomatic events, and is itself a symbol of status.
info.dragonrise_reforge.tunguska: 2K22 Tunguska gun-missile integrated air defense system, a short-range self-propelled air defense weapon system developed by the former Soviet Union/Russia. Equipped with two 30mm 2A38 twin-barrel cannons and eight 9M311 air defense missiles, it is mainly used to engage low-altitude and very-low-altitude aircraft and ground targets, with powerful firepower and rapid reaction capability.
info.dragonrise_reforge.type100: ZTZ-100 main battle tank, a fictional future main battle tank model that may build on the experience of the Type 99A but adopts next-generation tank technologies such as more advanced all-electric armor, electromagnetic guns or electrothermal-chemical guns.
info.dragonrise_reforge.type3: Type 3 Ka-Chi, an amphibious transport vehicle used by the Imperial Japanese Navy during World War II. Capable of sailing on water and landing directly on beaches, it played an important role in the island campaigns of the Pacific theater.
info.dragonrise_reforge.type97: Type 95 Ha-Go, the main light tank of the Imperial Japanese Army during World War II. Armed with a 37mm tank gun with thin armor but high speed, it was mainly used for reconnaissance and infantry support, and was widely used in the China and Southeast Asia theaters.
info.dragonrise_reforge.type97q: Type 97 Chi-Ha, the main medium tank of the Imperial Japanese Army during World War II. Armed with a 57mm short-barreled tank gun with thin armor but good mobility, it was the core of Japanese armored forces in the early war in China and the Pacific.
info.dragonrise_reforge.uh60: UH-60 Black Hawk helicopter, a four-bladed, twin-engine utility helicopter renowned worldwide for its ruggedness, versatility and excellent survivability, performing assault transport, electronic warfare, medical evacuation and many other missions.
info.dragonrise_reforge.ural4320: Ural-4320, a Russian 6x6 military truck produced by Ural Automotive Plant, widely used for logistics transport and as a platform for various military systems.
info.dragonrise_reforge.ural4320_supply: Ural-4320 Supply, a logistics variant of the Ural-4320 truck modified to carry ammunition and supplies, providing rear-area support for frontline units.
info.dragonrise_reforge.ural4320_zu23: Ural-4320 ZU-23, a self-propelled anti-aircraft vehicle with a ZU-23-2 twin 23mm cannon mounted on a Ural-4320 truck chassis, providing low-altitude air defense and fire support.
info.dragonrise_reforge.vt4a1: VT4A1 main battle tank, an improved variant of Norinco's export VT4 main battle tank, unveiled at the Zhuhai Airshow with a new paint scheme. It may have upgraded active protection systems or a more advanced remote weapon station, showcasing the latest technology of the Chinese tank industry.
info.dragonrise_reforge.vt4b: VT4B main battle tank, a customized model of the VT4 tank for specific customers such as Algeria. It may have adaptive adjustments in armor modules, communications systems or power packs to meet the combat environments and system requirements of different countries.
info.dragonrise_reforge.wlhgzu23: Wuling Hongguang ZU-23 self-propelled anti-aircraft gun, a product of folk ingenuity or a low-tech modified vehicle. A Soviet ZU-23-2 twin-barrel anti-aircraft gun is simply mounted on the famous Wuling Hongguang van, crude and straightforward, offering extremely low cost and a certain degree of mobile air defense capability.
info.dragonrise_reforge.wlsc: Wuling Hongguang cargo pickup, a simple pickup converted from the famous Wuling Hongguang platform. The rear seats are removed and a cargo bed is added, making it an economical light logistics vehicle widely used for civilian and low-intensity conflict logistics transport.
info.dragonrise_reforge.z10a: Z-10A attack helicopter, China's first dedicated attack helicopter. Featuring a tandem two-seat layout and a narrow fuselage with some armor protection and infrared suppression measures, it can carry anti-tank missiles and rockets to provide aerial fire support for the army.
info.dragonrise_reforge.z10me: Z-10ME attack helicopter, the export improved variant of the Z-10A. Fitted with a more powerful WZ-9G turboshaft engine and optimized engine intakes and exhausts for hot and high-altitude environments, it enhances crashworthiness and situational awareness systems, making it the flagship export product of China's high-end attack helicopters.
info.dragonrise_reforge.z20: Z-20 tactical utility helicopter, also known as Shen Diao-20, China's fourth-generation medium twin-engine multirole tactical utility helicopter, designed by AVIC Helicopter Research and Development Institute and manufactured by Harbin Aircraft Industry Group. Featuring a single main rotor with tail rotor and low rear horizontal stabilizer configuration, it is the first domestic helicopter to use fly-by-wire controls, equipped with domestic turboshaft engines, integrated low-drag aerodynamics and high-performance rotor design, and rotor de-icing technology. It has all-domain, all-weather deployment capability for airborne transport missions in day/night complex weather, with both plain and plateau performance and expansion compatibility.
info.dragonrise_reforge.z9: Z-9 helicopter, a light multirole helicopter produced by Harbin Aircraft Industry Group, a localized version of the French Dauphin helicopter. Widely equipped by the Chinese Army, Navy and Air Force, it can perform transport, reconnaissance, search and rescue, anti-submarine and fire support missions.
info.dragonrise_reforge.zbd04a: ZBD-04A tracked infantry fighting vehicle, a major improvement of the Type 04 IFV. It strengthens frontal and side armor protection, especially optimized against IEDs and mines, and is fitted with more advanced commander and gunner sights with higher informatization, operating in coordination with the Type 99A tank.
info.dragonrise_reforge.zbd05: ZBD-05 Amphibious IFV, the infantry fighting vehicle variant of the Type 05 amphibious armored vehicle family. Equipped with a 30mm autocannon and HJ-73D ATGM, it can carry 7 infantrymen to accompany assault forces with high-speed amphibious capability.
info.dragonrise_reforge.zbl08: ZBL-08 wheeled infantry fighting vehicle, one of the core equipment of the PLA Army rapid reaction forces. With high mobility and amphibious floating capability and fast road speed, it can be airlifted by Y-20 and other large transport aircraft for rapid deployment.
info.dragonrise_reforge.zlt11: ZLT-11 wheeled assault vehicle, developed on the Type 09 8x8 wheeled armored vehicle chassis and mainly armed with a 105mm rifled gun. It can effectively engage enemy main battle tanks and fortified positions at long range, combining the firepower of a tank with the strategic mobility of a wheeled vehicle, and is jokingly called the Big Eight-Wheeler.
info.dragonrise_reforge.zsl10: ZSL-10, a Chinese 6x6 wheeled armored personnel carrier, used for troop transport and reconnaissance in rapid reaction units.
info.dragonrise_reforge.zsu234: ZSU-23-4M self-propelled anti-aircraft gun, a Soviet tracked SPAAG armed with four 23mm AZP-23 cannons and an RPK-2 gun-laying radar. It was the main field air defense equipment of Warsaw Pact countries during the Cold War, known as the Shilka.
info.dragonrise_reforge.ztd05: ZTD-05 Amphibious Assault Vehicle, a member of the Type 05 amphibious armored vehicle family. Armed with a 105mm rifled gun, it features a hydrodynamic hull and water-jet propulsion for excellent high-speed water navigation.
info.dragonrise_reforge.ztq15: ZTQ-15 lightweight main battle tank, also known as the Type 15 tank, specially developed for complex terrain such as plateaus, mountains and water-net rice paddies. Despite its light weight, it is equipped with a 105mm gun and advanced fire control with high informatization, able to use terrain advantages to contend with heavy tanks.
info.dragonrise_reforge.ztz59a: ZTZ-59A main battle tank, an improved variant of China's first domestically produced Type 59 tank. By adding a laser rangefinder, two-axis gun stabilization and night vision equipment, this old tank gained the basic characteristics of a modern main battle tank and long served as the absolute mainstay of the PLA armored forces.
info.dragonrise_reforge.ztz96a: ZTZ-96A main battle tank, an improved variant of the Chinese Type 96 tank. Equipped with a 125mm smoothbore gun, new composite armor and a digital fire control system, it is the main equipment of the PLA armored forces.
info.dragonrise_reforge.ztz99a: ZTZ-99A main battle tank, one of the most advanced main battle tanks of the Chinese Army. Comprehensively improved from the Type 99, it is fitted with a more powerful engine, a new hydraulic transmission system and a more advanced digital battlefield management system, with its wedge-shaped turret and composite armor providing excellent protection.
info.dragonrise_reforge.ztz99ah: ZTZ-99AH main battle tank, a further improved variant of the ZTZ-99A with enhanced armor and upgraded fire control systems, representing the latest development of the Chinese main battle tank family.
info.dragonrise_reforge.ztz99bh: ZTZ-99B main battle tank (add-on armor, heavy weapon station), a further improvement of the Type 99A. Thicker explosive reactive armor is added to the turret and hull, possibly integrating a small AESA radar and a larger remote weapon station, greatly enhancing overall protection and situational awareness.
info.dragonrise_reforge.zu23: ZU-23-2 twin-barrel anti-aircraft gun, a Soviet towed 23mm twin-barrel anti-aircraft gun with a simple structure, great power and high rate of fire. Widely used against low-flying aircraft, light armored vehicles and infantry, it has appeared in large numbers in conflict zones around the world.
